title: Suction gripper for various objects with different surfaces

features.item: A housing with a grip portion designed as a hollow body for gripping
An electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing
features.quote: The limited inner vacuum space (11) and limited outer vacuum space (10) are connected to a vacuum source (13).
features.note: The reference discloses a vacuum source (13) which is implicitly electrically operated in the context of a suction gripper.
features.refuted: Quote only mentions connection to a vacuum source, not an electrically operated vacuum generating device in the housing.

features.item: Exhaust air from the vacuum generating device guided through the hollow grip portion to an air outlet
A sound-damping device arranged in the grip portion
A suction plate with carrier plate and seal extending around the carrier plate
features.quote: The suction pad (1) has an absorbent portion (2) that is provided with annular inner sealing lip (3) and annular outer sealing lip (4).
features.note: The suction pad (1) with its absorbent portion (2) acts as a suction plate, and the inner and outer sealing lips (3, 4) act as seals extending around it.

features.item: A grip unit with hollow grip portion, electrically operated vacuum generator, exhaust air routed through grip to outlet, and sound-damping in grip
Grip unit and suction plate combined in a vacuum handling apparatus
features.quote: Suction gripper (1) for sucking objects (5), comprising a suction body (2) which has an approximately annular inner sealing lip (3) and an outer annular surrounding outer sealing lip (4)
features.note: The suction gripper (1) combines the suction body (suction plate) and implicitly a grip unit for handling objects.
features.refuted: Quote describes only a suction gripper with sealing lips, not a combination of grip unit and suction plate in a vacuum handling apparatus.

features.item: Grip portion at least partially lined with sound-damping material
Vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion
Sound-reducing device in the first housing portion or first housing portion lined with sound-reducing material
Grip portion elongated between first and second housing portions with air outlet on second housing portion
Air collection screw upstream of grip portion in first housing portion for collecting exhaust air
Bent or curved air baffles downstream of grip portion directing exhaust air to air outlet
Battery coupling point on second housing portion with air baffles directing exhaust air away from battery coupling point
Grip unit and suction plate releasably connected via a coupling device
Grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate
features.quote: The limited inner vacuum space (11) and limited outer vacuum space (10) are connected to a vacuum source (13).
features.note: The vacuum source (grip unit) is connected to the inner and outer vacuum spaces (suction chambers) delimited by the sealing lips (suction plate).
features.refuted: Quote mentions vacuum spaces connected to vacuum source but does not teach a grip unit with suction opening fluidically connected to suction chamber delimited by suction plate.

This reference describes a suction gripper, but does not mention a vacuum generating device arranged completely in a first housing portion.

claims.quote: Suction gripper (1) for sucking objects (5), comprising a suction body (2)
claims.note: The reference describes a 'suction gripper' which is a type of vacuum handling apparatus.
claims.refuted: The quote describes a 'suction gripper' not a 'vacuum handling apparatus' - these are different terms for potentially different scopes of device.

claims.quote: The suction pad (1) has an absorbent portion (2) that is provided with annular inner sealing lip (3) and annular outer sealing lip (4).
claims.note: The reference discloses a suction pad with sealing lips, but does not explicitly mention a separate carrier plate to which the seal is fastened.
The reference describes a suction gripper, but there is no 'grip unit according to claim 1' in this document, as claim 1 of this reference describes the suction gripper itself.
This reference describes a suction gripper but does not mention a grip unit or a coupling device for releasably connecting a grip unit and a suction plate.

claims.quote: The limited inner vacuum space (11) and limited outer vacuum space (10) are connected to a vacuum source (13).
claims.note: The reference discloses vacuum spaces connected to a vacuum source to generate a vacuum, which is similar to a suction chamber and suction opening. However, it does not explicitly mention a 'grip unit' having a 'suction opening' or a 'suction plate' as distinct components in the context of the claim.
